description: This file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter that passes only the log message, removing other log metadata, intended for simplified on-screen logging.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter that only outputs the log message, omitting other metadata, used for simplified log output.
